lines.t: 20 years of fire and ink
Trumpet in the night, I heard you call my name
Left my fields and broke my nets
Walked out of the camps of men in holy shame
A pilgrim with the volumes open
Sword of the Word held tight in my hand
I thought my feet were on your mountain
But I was building my own promised land
You took my hand and set a mirror
Right in the chambers that I never let you see
You drew a map of every idol
Every little throne I swore I'd burn for thee
You showed me Egypt in my footsteps
Pharaoh's heart beating under my skin
A Jordan cross that gods of self sat down
Where you alone had reigned with them
Spirit of burden tore my heart
Name every lie that keeps us apart
I thought I had left, but I see it now I went back to Egypt and took a bow
This is my lamentation A wail on the walls of my own soul
I am the man who preached your freedom
Yet crawled back into the chains I stole
But in this crushing revelation
I feel your mercy in the weight I bear
Yeah, who should tear down my foundation
Be my sufficiency
See, my only prayer
I drank from broken cisterns
Self-reliance like a river in my veins
I cried my fear and called it wisdom
Let shame and pain hold the reins
Philosophy became my pharaoh
Pride of mine, a chariot of steel
I talked across the sang of dying
But kept my hands upon the wheel
You showed me altars to my image
Graving thoughts that bore religion's face
I hid behind the right confession
Yet would not fall into your grace
A son who quoted every promise
But would not rest in Abba's hand
Oh, you're roaring in your language
Yet defending his own little land
Spirit of truth lay bare my chest
Right idolater across my breast
I thought I was free but the chains still ring
I fear the cross more than anything
This is my lamentation
A whale on the walls of my own soul
I am the man who preached your freedom
Yet crawled back into the chains I stole
But in this crushing revelation
I feel your mercy in the weight I bear
Yahushua, tear down my foundation
Be my sufficiency
My only prayer
I am Israel in the wilderness
Longing for leaks with manna in my hand
I am the son who left the altar
To build again on sinking sand
I am the branch that feared the pruning
Hiding thorns behind the leaves I show
But you are the vine that will not let go
You cut me deep so that I may grow
Press me down till the dross runs out
Till philosophy cracks and the idols shout
Then silence them all with a single breath
Teach my proud heart the beauty of death
Break my defenses of holy pain
Wash off the doctrines carved in my brain
Right on my forehead, grace alone
Make trust in You my only throne
This is my lamentation
A whale on the walls of my own soul
I am the man who preached Your freedom
Yet crawled back into the chains I stole
Yet in this holy devastation
I see your love in the tears I cry
Yeah, who's your God of my salvation
To teach this wandering son to die
Take my 20 years of striving
Lay them down beneath your pierced feet
If all I keep is simple trusting
Let that loss be my victory complete
I was a slave in my own wisdom
Now I fall on a rock I used to defend
Crucify my self-made kingdom
Raise me a child to trust again.
